title: Creative ID Source
description: Who assigned a creative's creative_id. Fixed for the creative's lifetime: it records the origin of the identifier, not who last modified the creative.

enumDescriptions.buyer: A buyer supplied the creative_id through AdCP (any principal on the account).
enumDescriptions.seller: The creative entered the seller's library outside sync_creatives (seller UI or API, automation, or another system) and the seller assigned the creative_id.
